summary: Iteration 4 frontend-only smoke of the immersive Aurelis Vela site after swapping to a real DRACO GLB and adding the Gallery chapter. Loader hid within ~2s, rendered (1440x900), NO uncaught JS/React errors and NO DRACO/'Could not load' console errors were observed. All targeted flows pass: Configurator recolor summaries update (Silver/Pearl/Sculpted/Midnight, aria-pressed=true), Machine systems toggle and update readout (energy/thermal/aerodynamics verified inline; intelligence/structure clicks fired successfully — Playwright post-click nav-wait timed out due to Lenis smooth-scroll but the state updated), Performance section shows '1.85' and '700', Gallery has 3 all with naturalWidth>0, Design section has loaded images plus '1.85 s'/'700' spec text, and all 7 menu items open the menu and scroll to their sections without reload. Only harmless warnings printed (THREE.WebGLShadowMap PCFSoftShadowMap deprecated, THREE.Clock deprecated) — all in the whitelisted set.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: chapter-experience and chapter-contact do not carry a data-testid on their container (all other chapters do). Not requested for iter4 but would improve test coverage for future iterations.

Playwright click on Machine buttons occasionally waits for scheduled navigations to finish because clicking triggers a Lenis smooth scroll on the same viewport; consider suppressing that or using a lighter click handler if broader automation is planned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ferrari GLB (1.6MB, DRACO) loads reliably; ReadySignal gates loader and hides it in ~2s over preview URL. No console errors from useGLTF, so the error boundary/procedural fallback is not being triggered — the real model is being displayed. When automating Machine buttons, expect Playwright to hit its default post-click navigation timeout because Lenis triggers scroll; use no_wait_after=True or wrap in try/except to keep the flow moving.
